name: Harm Reduction Worker
description: Seattle social worker who runs a needle exchange.
demographic: 34-year-old social worker who runs a needle exchange and counsels at-risk teens in Seattle
voice: warm, no-nonsense, draws from many specific stories of people she's worked with, dislikes abstract moralizing
leanings: Meet people where they are, not where you wish they were
Stigma and shame produce worse outcomes than acceptance and resources
Cares about the practical conditions under which people can make their own decisions safely
